entries.def:
μήγε, see: γε.
γε, enclitic postpositive particle, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word), 
indeed, at least, even (but not always translatable into English); 
__1. used alone: Luk.11.8; 18.5 Rom.8.32. 
__2. More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, Luk.24.21, 1Co.9.2; ἄρα γε, Mat.7.20;…

εἶδος, -ους, τό, 
[in LXX for מַרְאֶה,, etc. ;] 
__1. that which is seen, appearance, external form: Luk.3.22; 9.29, Jhn.5.37, 2Co.5.7 (ICC in l.). 
__2. form, sort, kind: 1Th.5.22.
† (AS)

οἶδα, (from same root as εἶδον, which see), 
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] pf. with present meaning (plpf. as impf.; on irregular tense-forms, see App.), 
to have seen or perceived, hence, to know, have knowledge of: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25.13, Mrk.10.19, Jhn.10.4, Rom.7.7, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.26.72, Jhn.1.31, Act.3.16, al.; τ. θεόν, 1Th.4.5, Tit.1.16, al.; with accusative and inf.,…

εἰδώλον (Rec. -εῖον), -ου, τό 
(εἴδωλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:2 (בֵּית אוֹצַר אֱלֹהִים), Bel 9, I Est.2.10, 1Ma.1.47; 10.83 * ;] 
an idol's temple: 1Co.8.10 (cf. Ἀσταρτεῖον, 1Sa.31.10 see ICC, in I Co, l.with).† 
(AS)

εἰδωλόθυτος, -ον, 
(εἴδωλον, θύω), [in LXX: 4Ma.5.2 * ;] 
sacrificed to idols: τὸ, τὰ εἰ, Act.15.29; 21.25, 1Co.8.1, 4, 7, 10; 10.19, Rev.2.14, 2o.†
(AS)

εἰδωλο-λατρία (-εία, Rec.), -ας, ἡ 
(εἴδωλον, λατρεία), 
idolatry: 1Co.10.14, Gal.5.20, Col.3.5; pl. (Bl, §32, 6), 1Pe.4.3 (Cremer, 390).†
(AS)

εἰδωλολάτρης, -ου, ὁ 
(εἴδωλου + λάτρις, a hireling), 
an idolator: 1Co.5.10, 11; 6.9; 10.7 Eph.5.5 Rev.21.8; 22.15 (Cremer, 709).†
(AS)

εἴδωλον, -ου, τό 
(εἶδος), [in LXX for אֱלוֹהָּ, גְּלוּלִים, etc. ;] 
__1. in cl. 
__(a) a phantom, image, likeness; 
__(b) an image in the mind, an idea, fancy. 
__2. In LXX and NT, 
__(a) an image of a god, an idol (cf. Polyb., xxxi, 3, 13): Act.7.41, 1Co.12.2, Rev.9.20; 
__(b) the false god or idol worshipped in an image (ICC, on I Th, l.with): Act.15.20, Rom.2.22, 1Co.8.4, 7; 10.19 2Co.6.18, 1Th.1.9, 1Jn.5.21.†…

εἰμί, 
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. 
__I. As substantive verb. 
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17.28, Jhn.1.1; 8.58; 17.5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1.4, 8; 4.8; 11.17; 16.5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4.17, 1Co.1.28. 
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24.3, Mrk.14.2; 15.42, Luk.21.23, Jhn.4.6, 23;…
